name: T cell signaling and Fas-regulated activation-induced death
rationale: Members cover T cell activation signaling (including allograft rejection) and its Fas-controlled activation-induced death, unlike confusables centred on Th/Treg regulation or general death-receptor apoptosis.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Viral attachment and receptor-mediated endocytic entry
rationale: Members describe virus attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and host-cell transport (RSV, Dengue, influenza), distinct from confusables about viral protein maturation, cell-cell fusion or host suppression of viral life cycle.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation, survival and organ size
name: Kidney development control of progenitor proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney and nephric duct development through mesenchymal progenitor proliferation, apoptosis, stem cell maintenance and kidney size, unlike confusables focused on ureteric bud branching or metanephric epithelial differentiation.

name: Protein aggregate autophagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members concern clearance of misfolded proteins by aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, together with stress granule assembly and disassembly, which the confusables lack.

name: Catecholamine transport and norepinephrine transporter reuptake
rationale: Members cover monoamine/catecholamine transport with norepinephrine uptake and SLC6A2 defects, distinguishing them from dopamine-transporter, vesicular loading and dopaminergic synaptic confusables.

name: Osteogenic progenitor proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation and bone mineralization, unlike confusables on chondrocyte/RUNX2 skeletal development or osteoclast bone resorption.

name: Monocyte and neutrophil inflammatory activation and degranulation
rationale: Members are monocyte/neutrophil-enriched modules with inflammatory response, complement receptor signaling and neutrophil degranulation, distinct from confusables on tissue macrophages, FPR chemotaxis, respiratory burst and Fc receptor signaling.

name: Histone and protein lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation
rationale: Members cover lysine and arginine methyltransferases, demethylases, WDR5/KMT2D complexes and non-histone (p53) methylation, unlike confusables on PRC2/CpG imprinting or CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling.

core: Oncogenic ERBB2 and EGFR variant signaling
name: Oncogenic ERBB2 and EGFR mutant signaling and drug resistance
rationale: All members are cancer ERBB2/EGFR mutant or overexpression signaling and resistance to ERBB-targeted drugs, distinguishing them from FGFR/PDGFR/ALK cancer variants and normal ERBB2 downstream signaling.

name: mRNA polyadenylation, stabilization and decay
rationale: Members span mRNA 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation, export, decapping/decay and protection from decay, unlike confusables centred on ARE/miRNA-mediated destabilization or histone mRNA processing.

core: Response to iron and heavy metal ions
qualifier: heme oxygenase oxidative stress and ferroptosis
name: Iron and heavy metal oxidative stress response and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to iron, lead, mercury, cobalt and selenium with HMOX1/BACH1 oxidative stress control and ferroptosis, distinct from metallothionein/zinc-cadmium and iron import confusables.

name: Cholesterol efflux and lipoprotein transport restraining foam cell formation
rationale: Members promote cholesterol efflux and lipoprotein transport while limiting storage and macrophage foam cell formation, unlike confusables on LDL receptor uptake, HDL assembly or SREBP-driven biosynthesis.

qualifier: phase II methylation, acetylation and sulfonation
name: Xenobiotic metabolism via phase II methylation, acetylation, sulfonation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic and toxin detoxification through conjugation (methylation incl. TPMT/azathioprine, acetylation, sulfonation), distinct from confusables focused on CYP/FMO oxidative phase I reactions.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate metabolism in ammonium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine/aspartate metabolism, arginine catabolism and ammonium handling, distinct from confusables on alanine/gluconeogenesis, proline/glycine, urea cycle disorders or malate-aspartate shuttle.

core: Nucleotide deamination editing in viral restriction
name: Nucleotide deamination editing and translational repression restricting viruses
rationale: Members combine ADAR/APOBEC deaminase editing and host suppression of viral replication with translational silencing, distinct from confusables on HIV/coronavirus replication or DNA demethylation repair.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of ALK mutants
rationale: All members are ALK mutants resistant to specific ALK inhibitors, distinguishing the theme from KIT/PDGFR and FGFR oncogenic variant confusables.

name: Endothelial and platelet adhesion and vascular morphogenesis
rationale: Most members are endothelial, perivascular, megakaryocyte-platelet and adhesion modules (B cell and glucocorticoid-target modules fit loosely), distinct from smooth muscle SRF and fibroblast stromal confusables.

name: Tubulin folding, acetylation, glutamylation and microtubule severing
rationale: Members cover tubulin acetylation, polyglutamylation/deglutamylation, post-chaperonin folding and microtubule depolymerization, distinct from histone acetylation, ciliary assembly, CCT folding and sperm confusables.

name: Golgi ribbon disassembly-reassembly and intra-Golgi trafficking
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon/stack organization, disassembly, reassembly and positioning together with intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic, unlike confusables limited to vesicle budding or COPI retrograde traffic.

name: COPI retrograde budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER/Golgi vesicle targeting, distinct from COPII export and tethering confusables.

name: Prostate glandular epithelial differentiation and growth
rationale: All members describe prostate gland growth, acinus morphogenesis and glandular epithelial differentiation, distinct from mammary, salivary and pancreatic gland confusables.

name: Regulation of early thymocyte and B-progenitor development
rationale: Members regulate hematopoietic progenitor, immature thymocyte proliferation/survival and pro-B differentiation, unlike confusables on thymic selection, T cell activation or bone marrow homeostasis.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination, synapsis and checkpoint
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex, telomere attachment and checkpoint control, distinct from confusables on meiotic chromosome segregation, spindle and spermatogenesis.

name: Fatty acid catabolism with branched-chain phytanate alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members are short-, medium- and long-chain fatty and organic acid catabolism including phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl-CoA oxidation, unlike confusables on mitochondrial beta-oxidation steps, carnitine and cofactor metabolism.

qualifier: FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades
name: FGFR downstream FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 adaptor-mediated downstream cascades (FRS, SHC, PI3K, PLC-gamma) with Klotho ligand binding, distinct from confusables on FGFR isoform ligand binding, mutants or generic RTK downstream signaling.
